  "explanation": <one sentence>}

Case: Patient D is a 57-year-old Asian woman who is post-op day 5 status-post L4-L5 transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion for severe back and leg pain. When you examine Patient D, you confirm that she has no new neurological deficits, and does have persistent pain at her lumbar surgical site.
